messages:
sara_cs: OK team, starting a short 'EBR safety-net' sync to tidy slides and surface any renewal flags before next Tue. Aim: slide ownership, demo resiliency checks, and a compact list of commercial levers for renewals. Please skim the deck and call dibs.

devin_am: Link please? I'll take the commercial levers + renewal talking points if that's free.

sara_cs: Deck: https://redwood-co.slides/ebr/safety-net-v2 (CS edit access). Devins reserved for levers.

ana_csm: I'll cover onboarding KPI slide and a brief note on time-to-first-value. FYI two customers are under 50% activation at week 2, adding to notes.

ryan_eng: I can validate demo resilience tomorrow morning. What specific failure cases do you want covered?

sara_cs: Good Q. Please validate: 1) graceful fallback to text-only when gpt-style generation times out, 2) throughput at 100 concurrent demo sessions, 3) logs persisted to demo-analytics bucket, 4) feature-flag behavior for Private deployments.

ryan_eng: I'll run a lightweight concurrency spike against staging and check fallback timings. Running these commands: 
```
# run demo generation
curl -s -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"start demo"}],"max_tokens":120}'
# force fallback to small model
curl -s -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/chat?model=redwood-lite -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"start demo"}],"max_tokens":40}'
```
I'll post results here.

emma_pm: For the exec slide, propose a single 'ask' slide: (A) fund a 3-week onboarding sprint, (B) approve flexible discounting for at-risk renewals, and (C) sign off on demo runbook. I can draft the slide.

devin_am: Adding: request ability to use a one-time capacity credit for two renewals as a concession. Putting wording in speaker notes.

ana_csm: I also want a short script for AE follow-ups (3 bullet template) to surface onboarding blockers. I'll put it in slide notes.

infra-bot: Load test scheduled: 2026-03-26T09:00Z. Report will be uploaded to: https://ops.redwood/reports/ebr-safety-net-2026-03-26

sara_cs: Nice. Action checklist (track in deck):
- Ryan: staging resilience tests + report (due: 2026-03-26 12:00 PT)
- Ana: finalize onboarding KPI visuals + AE script (due: EOD today)
- Devin: finish renewal playbook bullets + commercial levers (due: EOD today)
- Emma: draft exec ask slide + contingency bullets (due: tomorrow AM)
I'll consolidate and run a 20-min dry run Mon 8:30am PT.

ryan_eng: Quick note: fallback latency looks ok under 50 concurrent sessions; starts degrading after ~180 sessions. Will include CPU/GPU traces.

devin_am: I've put negotiation play examples in the deck and added a line about Dedicated capacity promo being time-bound.

ana_csm: Added two customer quotes and a mini heatmap for activation cohorts. Marked accounts with renewal risk flags in the notes.

emma_pm: Drafted contingency flow: route demo traffic to fallback region + manual rollback checklist + comms template. Putting slide in deck.

sara_cs: Please also capture any ask for engineering resourcing on the slide so execs can approve tradeoffs.

infra-bot: Dry run invite created for Mon 08:30-08:50 PT. Attendees: sara_cs, devin_am, ana_csm, ryan_eng, emma_pm

sara_cs: Thanks all. If blockers pop up, drop them here or tag me. I'll publish the consolidated deck by EOD and share the dry-run calendar. :sparkles:
